_doc: src/shared/flightsim.ts: the kinematic flight simulator of the web (source `sim`; NOT PX4, NOT a real drone; every constant is plausible, none was fitted to the X500). Each scenario is a script of ops run on a fresh createSim(ambientC): `command` (simCommand with the wire message; the reply is recorded), `manual` (one simManual sample, recorded) and `run` (stepSim in steps of `dt`, feeding `sticks` through simManual before every step when given; a row is recorded every `every` seconds and at the end). `expect` lists the records in order, starting with the initial state: a string row (tokens separated by one space: mode, rtlPhase, armed, landed, pilot, then the numbers of `state_columns`, then those of `frame_columns`; "-" = null or non-finite) or a reply { reply, ok, detail, event }. The frame is simFrame(s, round(t * 1000)). The desktop port must reproduce every state number within `tolerance.state`, the frame numbers within `tolerance.frame` (the frame is rounded to 3 decimals: a value on a rounding edge may differ by one unit), the rpm within `tolerance.rpm` (integer rounding) and every string / flag / reply text exactly.

scenarios.name: sticks
scenarios.note: pilot, takeoff ending in manual, then forward, right, yaw, climb, descend and a combined stick; finally the sticks go quiet (dead-man)

scenarios.name: deadman
scenarios.note: forward stick, then no stick sample: after manualTimeoutS the model holds where it will have stopped; hold hands the sticks back

scenarios.name: geofence
scenarios.note: fly_to beyond the radius is clamped to it, a far fly_to too, forward sticks stop at the radius and the climb stops at the ceiling

scenarios.name: battery
scenarios.note: ten minutes of hover at 20 Hz: charge, current, voltage and the motor and battery temperatures evolve

scenarios.name: bigstep
scenarios.note: stepSim clamps a step to 50 ms: a 0.2 s step advances the clock by 0.05 s
